data.description: Wave 2, depends on the dispatcher extraction. SPEC IDs: EVT-1..EVT-8. File-first pub/sub: append-only NDJSON per-instance event log (seq, ts, type, refs, payload); v1 taxonomy = surface lifecycle, workspace select, canonical-metadata changes with source tier, derived-liveness transitions, waiting transitions, mailbox accepted/delivered; off-main non-blocking writes; size-capped rotation; c11 events tail --follow/--filter/--since as sugar over the file; envelope JSON schema in spec/; skill documents it all. <1s consumer latency. Contract: docs/cycles/2026-07-truth-and-stability/ (SPEC.md, EVALUATION.md, BUILDPLAN.md). Validation bar: tagged build + recorded scenario proof.

data.note: Wave 2 builds on the extracted dispatcher base

data.body: Plan posted (plans/task_01KWX7GBSX4DA3CS2KHCWZT5FB.md). Approach: clone the mailbox dispatch-log stack (MailboxDispatchLog + MailboxLayout) into a new Sources/Events/ set — a pure dual-target EventEnvelope + EventLogLayout, an app-only EventLog writer (serial .utility queue, lazy FileHandle, fire-and-forget append, seq assigned on-queue) adding size-capped rotation (events.ndjson → .ndjson.1 + log.rotated marker) and bounded-drop backpressure so a full disk never stalls the caller, and an EventEmitter.shared facade callable from any thread. v1 taxonomy is wired at the confirmed transition sites: surface.created (Workspace panel-insert helper) / surface.closed (bonsplit close funnel L11314) / workspace.selected (TabManager selectedTabId.didSet) / metadata.changed with source tier (Surface+Pane MetadataStore commit points, canonical-key + mutation gated, off-main) / waiting.entered|left (TerminalNotificationStore unread edge) / mailbox.accepted|delivered (MailboxDispatcher .received/.copied). derived-liveness rides a TEL (C11-162) seam — stub emitter if unlanded, logged in completion. c11 events tail (--follow/--filter type=/--since seq|duration) lands as a pre-socket CLI subcommand reading the file directly, modeled on mailbox tail/trace plus a non-follow one-shot. Ships spec/event-envelope.v1.schema.json + fixtures and skills/c11/references/events.md (+ sync). Validation: tagged build evt-post + recorded consumer-reacts scenario + <1s latency measurement. No new localized UI strings. STOP at pr_open for operator merge.

Plan-review infra note: the board's auto plan-review (triple/trident) spawned at 08:28 but died producing no artifacts — trident mode spawns c11 review panes and c11 new-pane failed with pane_too_small (pane:57 below the 640×340 minimum for a claude-code surface); --mode inline just delegates back to the author. Falling back to author-run independent review: three adversarial reviewers (SPEC-completeness / architecture+CLAUDE.md-compliance / codebase-accuracy) against the plan, contract, and the post-extraction worktree. Findings will be triaged into an authoritative amendment block on the plan. Flagging for the orchestrator in case trident plan/code-review needs a larger workspace or a headless backend for Wave 2 delegators.

Plan-review Cycle 1 triaged into an authoritative amendment block (plan §9). Three independent adversarial reviewers ran (author-run fallback after trident's pane-spawn failed): verdicts REWORK / APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES / APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES. Architecture stands (mailbox-clone writer, dual-target model, threading, and verified-exact code refs all confirmed; TEL derived-liveness confirmed unlanded → stub is correct). Resolutions folded in before build: (A, Critical) events --follow loop must be rotation-aware — the cloned offset-seek stalls after a roll; detect shrink/inode-change and reset. (B) assign seq AND serialize inside the writer queue (single ordering oracle; ts approximate). (C/D) single emitSurfaceCreated/emitSurfaceClosed chokepoints — the create map undercounted (add L9675/11708, adjudicate 11642) and close missed bulk-teardown (~11498) + detach (~9053). (E) surface-side prior value must be captured at the write site — WriteResult.priorValues is a never-populated stub on SurfaceMetadataStore (Pane populates it; asymmetry noted). (F, supersedes Risk #4) per-instance filename events-<instance>.ndjson — the shared file both misreads EVT-1 'per-instance' and risks non-atomic multi-writer corruption under the repo's documented prod+tagged dual-build dogfooding; CLI tails newest-by-mtime. (G) exclude progress from v1 metadata.changed (flood control). (H) waiting.* logged as a second TEL-6 seam; it's per-tab, hooked on the 0↔1 count edge. Plus minors: EVT-8 = behavioral fixture-validator + PR checklist (no source-text test), pure-envelope type hygiene, eager emitter init, c11Tests/ path, localize events usage text. No architectural re-review needed. Proceeding to awaiting-resume.

Plan revalidated against merged main (origin/main @ 16c9c2d2a, the C11-159 merge). All post-extraction anchors the plan + amendment depend on are intact and unshifted: SocketHandlers/ dispatch layer present; Mailbox writer analog (MailboxDispatchLog/MailboxLayout) unchanged; close funnel splitTabBar @ Workspace.swift:11253; TabManager selectedTabId.didSet guard @ 893; SurfaceMetadataStore priorValues stub @ 378 / setInternal @ 554 / setMetadataLocked @ 592 (confirms amendment E — surface-side prior must be captured at the write site); MailboxDispatcher .copied @ 372; CLI pre-socket seam (state @ 1699, SocketClient @ 1708) + mailbox tail/trace runners intact; c11-cli target + MailboxLayout dual-membership present; spec/ scaffolding present. 11 panels[..]= insertions confirm amendment C's expanded create-site set (will grep all at wiring time). No drift → no re-plan needed. Moving to in_progress.

COMPLETE → pr_open (PR #318, base main). Wave 2 stops here; operator merges. 

Shipped EVT-1..8: file-first NDJSON events stream. Core in Sources/Events/ (pure dual-target EventLogLayout+EventEnvelope compiled into app+c11-cli; app-only EventLog writer with on-queue monotonic seq, size-capped rotation to .ndjson.1 + log.rotated marker, bounded drop-and-report backpressure; EventEmitter.shared facade). Taxonomy wired at single chokepoints: surface.created/closed via a $panels Combine diff (catches split/tab/restore/reattach/rollback/bulk-teardown/detach — the amendment C/D undercount is moot with the diff approach), workspace.selected in selectedTabId.didSet, metadata.changed (canonical status/title/description + source tier + prior captured at the write site per amendment E; progress excluded per amendment G), waiting.entered/left on the unread edge, mailbox.accepted/delivered. CLI c11 events tail (--follow rotation-aware, --filter type=, --since seq|duration, --instance) pre-socket/no-app. spec/event-envelope.v1.schema.json + fixtures + skills/c11/references/events.md (installed copy synced).

Validation (tagged evt-post + recorded proof, all attached --role validation): real packaged app emitted correct events on FIRST launch (smoke-launch); every taxonomy member observed live; EVT-6 latency 267ms (<1s); EVT-7 consumer-reacts recorded; c11-logic EventLogTests 10/10; tests_v2 schema + live CLI-vs-file parity green.

Code review: auto code-review hit an empty-diff base bug (resolved parent checkout, not the worktree) → own-reviewer fallback, verdict SHIP. Fixed before landing: --follow dropped the rolled file's sub-second unread tail across a rotation (now drains .ndjson.1 first); doc/fixture drift corrected. Rebuilt green + re-validated.

SEAM DECISIONS (per BUILDPLAN seam rule): (1) liveness.derived consumes C11-162 (TEL) derived-liveness — TEL had NOT landed that signal in merged main (grep-confirmed), so the liveness.derived event type + a stub EventEmitter.emitDerivedLiveness(...) ship now behind no call site; TEL completes the wiring. (2) waiting.* rides a second TEL-6 seam (waiting-agent cluster) — currently the notification unread edge; rewire if TEL-6 redefines the signal. (3) pane-scoped metadata.changed deferred for v1 (the pane store is a lineage-title parity store, not the SPEC's canonical sidebar metadata). All three logged for TEL/orchestrator awareness.

Review basis for done: merged to main via GitHub PR (#318) after delegator inline review + drawbridge-review CI green; C4 Result Validator audited GREEN (0 Fail/0 Blocked). Attaching review role to satisfy completion policy — status reflects merged reality.
